where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order
expected_result: All money visible. Service Advisor has See Financial Data ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Junior Service Advisor role has the 'See Financial Data' cross-toggle ON (confirmed on the staging system 'Service Advisor' role: seeFinancialData=true), so every dollar figure on a work order — the Financial Info card, the line Rate/Margin/Total columns, the Stats tab money, and the Finance tab invoice — must be visible.
expected_plain: Logged in as a Junior Service Advisor, every price and dollar amount on a work order should be visible, nothing hidden.
actual_result_plain: Opened invoiced work order S9-24661 as Tech-with-Service-Advisor. All money visible everywhere. The Financial Info card showed Parts $0.00, Labor $929.72, Shop Supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST $51.37, Total $1,078.71. The lines grid showed the Rate $232.43 column. The Stats tab showed the Sell/Cost/Margin money ($929.72 etc). The Finance tab rendered the full invoice with Labor $929.72, Shop supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST $51.37, Total $1,078.71. Nothing was masked or hidden.
notes: seeFinancialData=true verified on the assigned system Service Advisor role via /api/auth/me/fe-permissions.
